theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Financials (+0.55%) and Utilities (+0.46%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-0.55%) and Real Estate (-0.34%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.10%, defensives +0.03%, and value/cyclicals +0.12% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.47%, Dow +0.27%, Nasdaq +0.97% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.35%. The VIX fell 3.99% to 16.62, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.34% to $4,150.00, crude oil was little changed at $97.28, and bitcoin gained 2.06% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
